plugins.name: copilot-skills
plugins.description: Personal Copilot CLI skills. Includes review-lens: review a Rust pull request, branch, commit or working-tree diff as an autonomous AI reviewing agent that proves its findings by checking out the head and building and running them — public API surface, constructors and defaults, dependencies and features, consistency, forensic correctness, performance, naming, telemetry, tests and docs — then posts a structured, AI-attributed review to the PR (GitHub review or Azure DevOps threads).
